snippet.title: Dragon Raja: ReRise Official Launch Today!
snippet.description:
🔥Download Now: https://drc-sea.onelink.me/t2FS/a5yu4tkp
🎁Join the event for a chance to win an iPad Air and Cash Prizes!

The adventure begins, the gates of the Dragon Clan are open,
Assemble now and embark on a new chapter together!

Dragon Raja: ReRise is now officially available on both platforms.
Adventurers can download the game on Google Play and App Store!

Download the game now and receive all Allies upon login, plus 400 free draws in the first week!
Multiple selectable SSR Allies are also available upon launch!

A brand-new Dragon Raja fantasy adventure packed with rewards is now underway—
Power Your Day—Tap, Clear, Slay!

🎁Download the game and leave your open beta wishes for a chance to win an iPad Air and Cash Prizes! 🎁

⏰Event Period⏰
From now until 2025/9/14 23:59 (UTC+8)

📌How to Join📌

Download Dragon Raja: ReRise from the App Store/Google Play

Like and follow the official Facebook page, then like and share the post

Leave your Official Launch wishes and a screenshot of successfully entering the game in the comments

🎁Event Rewards🎁
1 lucky adventurer will be randomly selected to win an iPad Air!
5 lucky adventurers will be randomly selected to win $50 each!

📪 For more information and the latest community updates:
Official Website: https://dragonrajaReRise.archosaur.com
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@DragonRajaReRiseSEA
TikTok: www.tiktok.com/@dragonrajarerisesea
Discord: https://discord.gg/wy2CkeDjgK

#DragonRajaReRise #DragonRaja
